Theme

Body, health & movement

run verb

also running, trot, jog, at a trot, run around, run up and down

classical

Traupman 60
Traupman 65

currō, currere, cucurrī, cursum

verb, third conjugation

Other words

  • tolūtim currere / cursitāre — trot, jog

    also used · modern

  • tolūtim — at a trot

    adverb · also used · classical · Traupman 60; Varro; Pliny

  • cursūra, cursūrae f. — running

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Plaut. Merc. 1.2.10 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 65

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut.; Varr.)

  • cursō, cursāre — run about, run to and fro

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 373

Examples

  • Theodōrus autem nōn ībat sed currēbat

    Theo, though, wasn’t walking but runningcomposed

  • ad olīvam tolūtim cucurrit truncumque manū tangēns «Valē, olīva!» inquit

    he trotted over to the olive tree and, touching the trunk, said, “Goodbye, olive tree!”composed

  • modo hūc modo illūc cursāre

    to run up and downTraupman 373

See also hurry, pant, tired.
